text:
alex: Heads-up — OrionCloud notified a manifest delay: 3 racks stuck at port. they asked if we can extend the reserved window by +10 days or reduce their insurance hold. need decision today.

maria: give me the reservation refs and which customers are on those pools.

alex: refs RSRV-9442, RSRV-9443, RSRV-9444. two Dedicated pools impacted (3 racks total). traffic low for a week but customer scale-up scheduled in ~10 days.

samir: operationally we can stretch 507 days without SLA impact; beyond that we risk throttling. partner prepay for expedited freight would buy time.

jen: legal cannot approve removing insurance requirement. SLA 4.2b obligates coverage. we need partner to confirm coverage in writing.

alex: @orion-partner can you confirm insurance will remain in force? also can you prepay expedited freight for any rush?

orion-partner: apologizing for the disruption 1 port backlog + customs paperwork. we will keep insurance. we can prepay expedited for two racks; the third needs an extra 305 days to confirm. can you accept a 7-day buffer instead of 10?

liz: ops: if we grant 7 days we can allocate one spare rack from the marketplace buffer and route it to SFO-3 as an interim. routing needs ~12h.

ben: finance math: full expedited cover = +$8k. if partner pays 50% now, we can absorb the rest and bill reconciliation after. need sales signoff for pass-through.

maria: suggested terms: 7-day one-off grace, partner confirms insurance, partner prepay 50% expedited within 24h, we allocate one buffer rack. legal to confirm amendment language.

samir: ops agrees but wants auto-fallback clause: if manifest not on the truck by day 7, automatically start variant-routing and cap those customer routes. I'll add a runbook.

jen: ok we can draft an amendment with those conditions. include insurance attestation + prepay deadline. send me the snippet.

alex: draft amendment below to send to partner:

```
Amendment: Redwood will provide a one-time 7-day capacity extension for reservations RSRV-9442, RSRV-9443, and RSRV-9444, conditioned on: (1) Partner maintains full cargo insurance for all shipments; (2) Partner prepays 50% of expedited freight costs within 24 hours of signing; (3) Partner supplies revised ETD within 72 hours. If any condition is unmet, Redwood will execute automatic fallback routing and invoice the partner for incremental costs.
```

orion-partner: confirmed in thread 1 we will upload insurance docs and prepay 50% within 12 hours. updated ETD for rack-3 is +5 days. thanks for flexibility.

ops-bot: action created PARTNERS-3709 1 provision marketplace buffer -> SFO-3, update reservations, customer notif. owner: samir. due: 12h.

alex: next steps: jen will send amendment, ben to send payment link, samir to execute buffer placement, maria to update marketplace reservation notes. i'll coordinate partner comms. :thumbsup:
